notes.title: BlackShot Revolution
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25084630/42b77c3c5d2ed395189f03a93955ebeb4950dae8.png[/img]

[h1] To the BlackShot Global Community, [/h1]

Oftentimes, games must undergo significant changes to remain competitive in the marketplace. For long-lived games this fact is even more evident, and BlackShot is no different. 
For this reason, [b] BlackShot is changing [/b].


Before detailing the coming changes, however, our team would like to first express our tremendous appreciation for all the dedicated members of our game community. Last year BlackShot surpassed its 10th year of service, an achievement seldom reached in the gaming industry, and we are truly humbled by your continued support that made such a feat possible.

In the four years that BlackShot Global has been operating directly under Vertigo Games/Papaya Play, our team has strived to continually improve the game experience in every possible. Some of these initiatives include: implementing the BattlEye Anti-Cheat system, introducing dedicated servers for the Brazilian community, adding Portuguese, German, and French as supported languages, and unifying all payment gateways for ease of access. Our goal is to make the game the best it can possibly be for everyone, and the changes coming later this month are the next step towards reaching that goal. 

While we know that you love BlackShot, and have for many years, it cannot be denied that the game’s legacy foundations are beginning to show. In the years since BlackShot’s release, FPS conventions have moved in many exciting new directions, especially in the Free-to-Play space, and our team believes introducing some of these can help iron out some of the game’s more contentious issues and make the overall experience more enjoyable for everyone.


Here’s [b] what this means for you [/b]:

Substantial system changes, more impactful than any our team have released in the past ten years, are coming July 25th. These changes are tantamount to a product relaunch, and we have collectively titled them BlackShot Revolution. 
In brief, BlackShot Revolution’s major changes/additions include:

[b] Total Weapon Rebalance [/b]

All weapons in BlackShot Revolution are completely permanent, and instead of timing out, will now degrade with use until they need to be repaired (this will not impact the weapon’s stats, however). This means no more lost gear or play time. Furthermore, every single weapon in the weapon in the game is being rebalanced to promote overall fairness and further strengthen competitive play.

[b] Streamlined Leveling [/b]

The Level-Up System is being streamlined and revamped with new rewards. Ranks are also now reflected by a single numerical value (ex. Level 58), making it easier for new recruits and seasoned Mercenaries alike to see how they measure up against the competition.

[b] Currency Overhaul [/b]

The BS and BSC currencies are both being replaced with the more thematically-appropriate Gold and Gems and having their functionalities significantly adjusted. Gold can be used to purchase most Shop items and perform other critical game functions, while Gems are exclusively reserved for purchasing Goldboxes and cosmetic/customization items.
The full details of these major changes, plus the rest of what BlackShot Revolution has to offer, will be revealed closer to the full launch date of July 25th. 


Now, for [b] the bad news [/b]:

The coming system changes are so substantial that the game data format must be completely reformatted, a process that will result in the loss of all existing player progression and set all accounts back to Level 1 under the new progression system. While the loss of data was never our goal from the outset of this project, it quickly became apparent in development that it was necessary for our vision for BlackShot to be fully realized.

Despite the data being removed, though, there will be carry-over into BlackShot Revolution for inventory items, ranks, and unused currency, including: 

[list]
[*]All inventory items, BS currency, and progression ranks, will be converted into the new Gold currency and credited to accounts when Revolution launches.
[*]All BSC currency in player accounts is being converted into Gems.
[*]Weapon Masteries and ranks will be immortalized in the new Hall of Fame, coming to the BlackShot Revolution website.
[/list]

As can be expected, given the nature of the wipe, [b] the Goldbox system will also be deactivated in-game [/b] until Revolution launches.

We do not expect this news to be met with enthusiasm by everyone in the community; indeed, it is one of the most difficult development choices we have had to make, and we know many will have strong feelings about it. All we ask for now is for you have trust in our team, and trust that these changes are what is best for the game we all love. We believe that Revolution will make the beginning of BlackShot’s next great chapter, and we invite all of you to join us for the journey.
We will keep you updated with more news through all of BlackShot’s official channels as the July 25th launch day approaches.

-	Team BlackShot

Try something new in 2018 with the New Years Resolutions Event! This event features 22 different daily missions, with each giving a unique weapon reward upon completion. Complete all of the event missions to receive the new Kaltec KSP Legion. The event will run from January 10th to January 31st.

Don't forget to register for the New Years Resolutions Event on the BlackShot website!

[h1] GoldBox Change [/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25084630/1ad5a1e76585cd25c7ddbeba60f50e4cf1e4fad7.gif[/img]

Start off strong in 2018 with the latest updates to the Goldbox offering. Supplement your arsenal with the potent MSR Venomphoenix and other deluxe weapons and battlefield gear available only for a limited time.

[h1] Map Boosts [/h1]

Get even more out of the New Years Resolutions missions with these map boosts. Like last year, playing on these maps will grant additional EXP and BP, giving even more benefits while you work to complete your daily missions. 

Maps below will have 300% EXP and 200% BP until further notice:

[list]
[*] School (TDM)
[*] Sniper Site (TDM)
[*] Scrap Yard (TDM)
[*] Station (WR)
[*] Summit (WR)

[h1] Protect the GM - Community Event [/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25084630/6bcaee30f62023dff197539ce83e2a6779522819.jpg[/img]

The Protect the GM Event brings Friday fun back to BlackShot in the new year. In the event, a GM is the captain of each team in a TDM match, and your objective is to protect them at all costs. The team with the fewest GM deaths at the end of the match is the winner. While all participants will receive prizes, the winning team and MVP will, of course, receive ones of higher value chosen by their GM.

These events will run every Friday from January 12th to February 3rd.

notes.title: BlackShot 10th Anniversary
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25084630/b4c6c70ec81df57a158efdc9bf57e62ee2de16a9.jpg[/img]

Happy 10th Anniversary BlackShot! In order to celebrate this momentous occasion, our team has prepared several special activities and prizes for all of our loyal Mercenaries. Get in on the madness with the new Weapon Race map Summit, or browse the available shop items and Goldboxes for famous legacy BlackShot items!

[h1]Let Them Wear Cake [/h1]
10 years is a very long time, especially for a video game, and our team can’t thank all of you Mercenaries enough for your continued support. Since we can’t share a piece of BlackShot’s birthday cake with everyone, we decided to instead give away a deliciously free, permanent item to mark the occasion. Log in on BlackShot’s birthday, November 14th, to receive the exclusive “10th Anniversary Flantastic Hat” – available for one day only!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25084630/5f2deecc2a35d7658b5358d8dcf919b819b171d2.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Summit Map[/h1]
Experience chilling arctic warfare on Summit, the newest map for Weapons Race! Speed through claustrophobic corridors in dangerous frozen close-quarters combat, where attacks can come from any direction!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25084630/327e148d43c9a885635519b1cd7872e725a878de.jpg[/img]

[h1]Anniversary Sales [/h1]
Gear up for BlackShot’s 10th Anniversary with these special legacy BlackShot sale items. We’ve returned some fan-favourite items from over the years to the Shop for a limited time, so grab them while you can and look your best for BlackShot’s big day! Also stay on the lookout for new Anniversary Goldboxes, containing a selection of extra-special BlackShot Birthday goodies!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25084630/da99e31c42ce40fab7929806e3cdf0ac99c8d2f6.png[/img]

notes.title: CS72: Fend For Yourself is live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25084630/1ee86319c8198fd92e6d30894b2554a82b4b06b6.gif[/img]

The BlackShot Global Team is proud to introduce [b]CS72: Fend For Yourself![/b] You asked, and in this update, we delivered with Free 4 All, BlackShot’s premier competitive free-for-all mode, a full revamp of the Clan System, and more!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25084630/586d2e61357831b23a90bb5e920d348c7daa6e4b.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][u]Free 4 All[/u][/b][/h1][list]
[*]It’s every Mercenary for themselves in BlackShot’s very first free-for-all mode
[*]Stay on your toes for ‘Hunting Time’, an in-game event that chooses one player as Prey and tasks all others with hunting them down
[*]Play Free 4 All to earn the new [b]Breaching Random Box[/b] that gives a chance to win the newly-added Claymore and more[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25084630/c584a50750b7bcf5ae876a4a5bba30bb4f81d4b2.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][u]Clan 2.0[/u][/b][/h1][list]
[*]The Clan system has been revamped with new [i]My Clan PT’s[/i], individual account-locked points which collectively contribute to a Clan’s leaderboard position
[*]Fight through the skill Tiers, from Bronze to Legend, to prove your Clan’s dominance. The top 10 players from the top 10 Clans in each Tier receive new Clan Goldboxes at the end of each 3-month ranking season*
[*]Complete weekly cooperative Clan Quests for a shot at exclusive rewards[/list]
 
[i]*Note: The currently active Clan War season will end on March 30th and the new season will begin on April 1st[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25084630/bb25ec3d758072c9fb87875ce18825cc48b11b78.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][u]New Weapons[/u][/b][/h1][list]
[*][b]Claymore[/b]
	The M18 Claymore Anti-Personnel explosive device provides unrivalled defenses for exposed combat engagements
[*][b]K17 Flashbang Grenade[/b]
	Optimized to breach fortified enemy locations, the K2 flashbang grenade is a versatile addition to any arsenal

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25084630/a9b447af009130bfe30074ec6015c9e4eea43177.png[/img]

[*][b]Barrett Omega[/b]
	This Omega edition of the Barrett is optimized for visual proficiency[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25084630/8da2ebf4d4a33906ddf2354e13b5406f5c2b1aa9.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][u]New Map: No Mercy[/u][/b][/h1]

A claustrophobic disused industrial yard with short sightlines and plenty of hiding places. Watch those corners!
 
[h1][b][u]Map Boosts (300% BP and 200% EXP):[/u][/b][/h1]

Panic Space SF
FFA Random (FFA)
Safe House
Desert Hawk (RM)
Cerebro
 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25084630/40d1b0519b024aeef2dcbf43e2b10958c25a596d.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][u]Improvements[/u][/b][/h1][list]
[*]Implemented BattlEye Anti-Cheat System to counteract exploitive external programs and improve game experience
[*]Improved ability to filter items in player storage and in the Shop
[*]Search and Destroy Mode now allows players to play both sides in each match[/list]

notes.title: Announcement on the New Anti-hack Solution
notes.content:
We’ve had varied feedback regarding our current program “GameGuard” in the past year, but despite the effort of the developers and engineers at GameGuard who have worked on enhancing back-end process to limit the hack uses and updated the solution almost daily basis, the hacking situation hasn’t been controlled at a very satisfactory level for the majority of our players.

After receiving many player feedback and outsourced consulting, we found one solution which has been frequently recommended by experts and our players. So we’ve researched and investigated the solution with the developers, and recently implemented it to our internal servers successfully.

After finalizing the implementation, we’d like to introduce it to the live server next week.

Please stay tuned for more information about this changes.

Best regards,
Team BlackShot, Papaya Play

notes.title: All New Steam DLC Process!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25084630/cc72cded1adecc4dada06b4262b94ee0f511ec25.jpg[/img]

There was a bunch of concern regarding our previous DLC process, where players had to go in game and then click on the Reload BSC Button which would then pop up a window where you had to put your DLC code into. 

That is no longer the case. You will now be able to purchase the DLC packages and the Package will automatically be attached to your account. 

Once you login, you will have to click on your character then join a Channel. A pop up message will let you know that the item was successful attached to your account and it should show up in your inventory within 2 minutes. 

If you don’t see the item in your inventory, go back to the character selection screen and rejoin a channel. Once you rejoin the channel it will be in your Inventory. 

This process is only effecting the the newer DLC package, we will be changing over the previous package at a later date.

notes.title: Are you ready to Rock Midsummer?
notes.content:
This bright weekend of midsummer, grab you mates and check out our new Rock 2 Map that we just released a bit ago. 

It provides you great opportunities to observe your opponents or quickly run for shelter if you need to reload your weapon behind one of the many blocks.

Make sure to keep moving as the sun on top of the mountain might burn you. Watch your step though – this map is not only beautiful but also fatal enough to break your leg.

BlackShot is a free-to-play, first-person shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world.Join other mercenaries in brutal team combat, multiple game modes, and experience in-depth customization to create your perfect warrior!

notes.title: Welcome to BlackShot!
notes.content:
We are super excited and happy to make the announcement that BlackShot, one of the world's leading mercenary groups has finally been launched on Steam!

The world the way we have known it stopped existing and has been replaced by a state of chaos in which the most powerful nations are in war for money and resources.
In order to wage the war, huge armies of clone soldiers have been conducted to fight the ultimate war on dangerous and gritty battlefields.
Every mercenary has the chance to rise from a lowly recruit all the way up to a commander-in-chief if they are brave and skilled enough to make it through all the battles. 

In BlackShot, players can experience deep character customizations with the opportunity to choose from of a large variety of weapons such as snipers, assault rifles, shotguns, SMGs and many more, as well as different tactics and equipment.
By rising up in ranks and expanding their skills, gamers can develop their mercenary into a lethal weapon.

Are you brave enough to become one of the elite soldiers in BlackShot’s ultimate warfare?
